operations.name: getBills
operations.description:
List All Bills
Returns all bills that meet the filter criteria

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional pagination parameters. The default parameters are recommended but can be modified if a different sized response is desired.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filters for bills. All GET requests must include a filter for `[Id]` (if available), or `[LastUpdatedAtFrom]`.

ApprovalStatus.description:
Example: `filters[ApprovalStatus]=Approved`
The bill's approval status. Filter the results based on a single value. Valid values include `All`, `Pending Approval` or `Approved`.

Id.description:
Example: `filters[Id]=537b8cd8-381d-11ea-827d-b083fed171ad,648b8cd8-381d-11ea-827d-b083fed171da`
Unique identifier of the bill to filter by. Filter the results based on one or more `Id`s. Multiple values should be separated by commas.

LastUpdatedAtFrom.description:
Example: `filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]=2021-12-15T16:30:46Z`
Returns bill records that have been updated since the date provided. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`, and the default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

IncludeHidden.description:
Example: `filters[IncludeHidden]=true`
Indicates whether or not to include bills associated with a property hidden by an AppFolio Property Manager user in the response

ManagementCompanyAsPayee.description:
Example: `filters[ManagementCompanyAsPayee]=true`
Indicates whether or not to include bills where the management company is the payee for the bill

ApprovalStatus.description:
Example: `filters[ApprovalStatus]=Approved`
The bill's approval status. Filter the results based on a single value. Valid values include `All`, `Pending Approval` or `Approved`.

Id.description:

Unique identifier of the bill to filter by. Filter the results based on one or more `Id`s. Multiple values should be separated by commas.

LastUpdatedAtFrom.description:
Example: `filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]=2021-12-15T16:30:46Z`
Returns bill records that have been updated since the date provided. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`, and the default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

IncludeHidden.description:
Example: `filters[IncludeHidden]=true`
Indicates whether or not to include bills associated with a property hidden by an AppFolio Property Manager user in the response

ManagementCompanyAsPayee.description:
Example: `filters[ManagementCompanyAsPayee]=true`
Indicates whether or not to include bills where the management company is the payee for the bill

operations.name: createBill
operations.description:
Create Bill
Create a bill

AccountNumber.description:
For utility billing. The account number associated with the bill, used by a utility vendor to identify the account.

**Note**: `WorkOrderId` and `AccountNumber` are mutually exclusive. Therefore, only one of them can be provided in the request.

CashAccountId.description: The general ledger account ID of the Cash Account the bill will be paid out of. If the property is corporate, the CashAccountID must be a corporate gl account. If it is not, it cannot be a corporate GL account

CreateCorporateCharges.description: When true, automatically create corporate charges for this bill. Only applies when `ManagementCompanyAsPayee` is true and Corporate Charge Automation is configured in Corporate Accounting Settings; otherwise no charges are created. Defaults to false when omitted.

DueDate.description: The date the bill is due

InvoiceDate.description: The date the invoice was received

ManagementCompanyAsPayee.description: Indicates whether the management company is the payee for the bill. Required and must be true when VendorId is null or not provided. When true and `CreateCorporateCharges` is also true, if Corporate Charge and Receipt Automation are configured in Corporate Accounting Settings, charges and receipts will automatically post.

PropertyId.description: Unique identifier of the property on the bill. If a `PropertyId` is not found within the `LineItem` array, use this value for reference purposes.

Reference.description: The reference number of the bill. This number must be unique, no duplicate record is allowed.

Remarks.description: A description or summary of the bill

TotalAmount.description: The total amount due. Ensure that the total amount is equal to the total of all line items summed.

VendorId.description: Unique identifier of the the payee's vendor ID. Required when ManagementCompanyAsPayee is false or not provided. When present, ManagementCompanyAsPayee cannot be true.

WorkOrderId.description:
Unique identifier of the work order corresponding to the bill(s). The value of `WorkOrderId` cannot be null.

**Note**: `WorkOrderId` and `AccountNumber` are mutually exclusive. Therefore, only one of them can be provided in the request.

| UnitId      | String | The unit ID relevant to the line item                                                                                       | UUID format e.g. "914a2a8e-f5d3-11e9-a485-1876da4c83b5" |

operations.name: getjobs
operations.description:
List All Jobs
Retrieve the status and per-record results of asynchronous bulk operations.

When you submit a request to an asynchronous bulk endpoint, it responds immediately with a `JobId`. Use this endpoint to poll that job until it reaches a terminal status (`finished` or `failed`), then read the per-record outcomes from `Result`.

#### Retrieving a job requires its Id

`filters[Id]` is required — jobs cannot be listed or discovered without it. Store the `JobId` from the bulk response when you submit the request. If you lose it, the results cannot be recovered.

#### Results are available for 7 days

Job results are retained for 7 days from when the bulk request was submitted, then deleted. After deletion this endpoint returns `200` with an empty `data` array, which is indistinguishable from an unrecognized `Id`. Treat this endpoint as a short-lived collection point rather than a queryable history: read the results and store them on your side.

#### Polling rate limit

This endpoint is limited to 5 requests per 15 seconds, which is stricter than the general API rate limits. Space out your polling accordingly, and prefer batching several job `Id`s into a single request over issuing a separate request per job.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filters for jobs

Id.description:
Example: `filters[Id]=3b5344d0-482b-4b50-b30f-2dd67412b517,1abcde23-c543-456e-abc9-123456789cba`
Unique identifier of the job. Filter the results based on one or more `Id`s. Multiple values should be separated by commas.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional pagination parameters. The default parameters are recommended but can be modified if a different sized response is desired.

Id.description:
Example: `filters[Id]=3b5344d0-482b-4b50-b30f-2dd67412b517,1abcde23-c543-456e-abc9-123456789cba`
Unique identifier of the job. Filter the results based on one or more `Id`s. Multiple values should be separated by commas.

anyOf.description: The URL path to the next page of responses. `null` on the last page.

Id.description: Unique identifier of the asynchronous bulk job. This is the `JobId` returned by the bulk endpoint that created it, and is the only way to retrieve the job — pass it as `filters[Id]` and store it when you submit the bulk request.

Status.description:
Indicates the current status of the asynchronous job. `finished` and `failed` are the only terminal statuses.
#### Status Options
| Options       | Description                                                          | Notes |
|---------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|-------|
| new           | The job was created, but processing has not started                  |       |
| pending       | The job is queued and waiting for an available worker                |       |
| running       | The job is actively being processed                                  |       |
| finished      | The job ran to completion. This does **not** mean every record succeeded — check `successful` on each entry in `Result` | Terminal |
| failed        | The job stopped on an unrecoverable error before it could record its results | Terminal. See `ErrorMessage` |

When `Status` is `failed`, `Result` is empty, so per-record outcomes are not available. Some records may already have been written, because records are processed individually rather than as a single all-or-nothing batch. Query the corresponding resource to determine what was written before resubmitting, otherwise you may create duplicates.

Result.description:
The per-record outcome of the bulk operation. `Result` is an empty array while the job is queued or processing, and also when `Status` is `failed`. When `Status` is `finished`, it contains one entry per record processed.

Match each entry back to the record you submitted using `ReferenceId` for bulk create operations, or `ResourceId` for bulk update operations. Do not match entries by array position, and do not assume the number of entries equals the number of records you submitted — neither is guaranteed.
#### Result Attributes
| Attributes   | Type    | Description                                                                                               |
|--------------|---------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ReferenceId  | String  | The identifier you supplied for this record in the original bulk create request. Not returned by every bulk update endpoint |
| ResourceId   | String  | Unique identifier of the record created or updated. `null` when the record failed |
| successful   | Boolean | Indicates whether this individual record was processed successfully |
| errors       | Array   | Plain-text reasons this record failed. Always present, and empty when `successful` is `true`. These are strings, not objects — unlike the `errors` returned in a `422` response from the bulk endpoint itself |

ReferenceId.description: The identifier you supplied for this record in the original bulk create request. Not returned by every bulk update endpoint.

anyOf.description: Unique identifier of the record created or updated. `null` when the record failed.

successful.description: Indicates whether this individual record was processed successfully.

errors.description: Plain-text reasons this record failed. Always present, and empty when `successful` is `true`.

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a message indicating the job encountered an unrecoverable error. Only present when `Status` is `failed`

Returns property records that have been updated since the date provided. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`, and the default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

PropertyType.description:
Example: `filters[PropertyType]=Single-Family,Multi-Family,Commercial`
Returns property records that match one or more of the specified property types. Multiple values should be separated by commas. Acceptable values are: Commercial, Manufactured-Housing, Mixed-Use, Multi-Family, Self-Storage, Single-Family, Student-Housing or Vacation

* If a custom attribute value exists, the key's value is set to that custom attribute value, as per the current functionality.

operations.name: bulkCreateTransferredPhotos
operations.description:
Bulk Create Transferred Photos
Copy existing photos in bulk from another database to properties, units and unit types in this database. Returns a 202 with a JobId; poll the Jobs endpoint for the per-photo results. If the property, unit or unit type has no existing default photo, the first photo transferred to it becomes its default, so send the photos of each entity in ascending Position order.

data.description: The photos to transfer. A maximum of 100 photos may be transferred per request.

ReferenceId.description: Transient unique ID assigned by the developer. Used to reference individual photos in the bulk-creation of transferred photos.

URL.description: The presigned Amazon S3 URL of the original file of an existing AppFolio photo, such as the Url returned by the photo list endpoints, which expires after 5 minutes. Must use the https scheme and be unexpired. Maximum file size is 10MB. The file must be a JPEG, PNG or GIF image. The width and height of the photo are read from the file. Marketing photos, such as unit type floor plan photos, are not supported.

EntityType.description: The type of entity the photo will be added to. For a single-family property, use the property rather than its unit. Photos cannot be added to a unit that uses the photos of its unit type (add them to the unit type instead), to a unit type that does not use unit type photos or belongs to an HOA property, or to a corporate property.

EntityId.description: The UUID of the entity the photo will be added to

Name.description: The file name of the photo. Only the last path segment is kept, control characters, invisible formatting characters and emoji are removed, and the extension is replaced with one that matches the file content. Defaults to photo when omitted, and is shortened to fit 255 characters.

Position.description: The position of the photo in the photo gallery, starting at 0. Positions are stored as given and are not adjusted for photos the entity already has.

JobId.description: Unique identifier for the job that was created to process the photo transfers

ReferenceId.description: Transient unique ID assigned by the developer. Used to reference individual photos in the bulk-creation of transferred photos.

WorkOrder.Status.title: Status
WorkOrder.Status.description:
**Deprecated — use `WorkOrderStatus` instead.** `Status` collapses several AppFolio Property Manager statuses (for example, "Completed No Need To Bill" is reported as "Completed" and "Work Done" as "Work Completed"). `WorkOrderStatus` reports the full, unflattened set of statuses. Example: `filters[Status]=Assigned,Canceled`
The status of the work order. Filter the results based on one or more statuses. Multiple values should be separated by commas. This filter is mutually exclusive with `WorkOrderStatus`; a request cannot filter by both. #### Status Options | Options | Description | |--------------------|----------------------------------| | Assigned | The work order has been assigned to an AppFolio Property Manager user | | Canceled | The work order has been canceled | | Completed | The maintenance request was closed out | | Estimate Requested | An estimate was requested from the vendor | | Estimated | An estimate was received | | New | A new maintenance request | | Ready to Bill | The work order is ready to be billed | | Scheduled | Work is scheduled | | Waiting | The work order is pending | | Work Completed | The work order is completed |

When used as a filter, results are filtered based on one or more statuses; multiple values should be separated by commas. This filter is mutually exclusive with the deprecated `Status` filter; a request cannot filter by both. #### Status Options | Options | Description | |---------------------------|----------------------------------| | Assigned | The work order has been assigned to an AppFolio Property Manager user | | Assigned by AppFolio | The work order was assigned by AppFolio Smart Maintenance agents or the system | | Canceled | The work order has been canceled | | Completed | The maintenance request was closed out | | Completed No Need To Bill | The work order was completed and does not need to be billed | | Estimate Requested | An estimate was requested from the vendor | | Estimated | An estimate was received | | New | A new maintenance request | | New by AppFolio | A new maintenance request created by AppFolio Smart Maintenance agents | | Ready to Bill | The work order is ready to be billed | | Scheduled | Work is scheduled | | Waiting | The work order is pending | | Work Done | The work has been completed |

WorkOrder.StatusForWriter.title: Status
WorkOrder.StatusForWriter.description:
**Deprecated — use `WorkOrderStatus` instead.** `Status` accepts a collapsed subset of AppFolio Property Manager statuses; `WorkOrderStatus` accepts the full, unflattened writable set (for example, "Completed No Need To Bill", "Work Done", and "Ready to Bill"). This attribute is mutually exclusive with `WorkOrderStatus`; a request cannot set both.

The status of the work order. The `Status` is automatically updated to `Estimate Requested` or `Estimated` based on the `Estimates` associated with it.
When one or more estimates exist on a work order, the work order status becomes `Estimate Requested`.
Once any estimate has an `Amount` provided, the work order status transitions to `Estimated`.
#### Status Options
| Options            | Description                      |
|--------------------|----------------------------------|
| Assigned           | The work order has been assigned to an AppFolio Property Manager user |
| Canceled           | The work order has been canceled                |
| Completed          | The maintenance request was closed out   |
| New                | A new maintenance request          |
| Scheduled          | The work order to be performed is scheduled                |
| Waiting            | The work order is pending                         |
| Work Completed     | The work order is completed                   |

WorkOrder.WorkOrderStatusForWriter.title: WorkOrderStatus
WorkOrder.WorkOrderStatusForWriter.description:
The status of the work order, matching the statuses available in AppFolio Property Manager. This attribute is mutually exclusive with the deprecated `Status` attribute; a request cannot set both. The read-only statuses `Estimate Requested` and `Estimated` (managed through the estimate flow) and `New by AppFolio` and `Assigned by AppFolio` (set by AppFolio Smart Maintenance agents or the system) cannot be set through the API. Some statuses require a companion attribute in the same request, shown in the "Required with" column below; omitting it returns a 422.
#### Status Options
| Options                   | Description                                                 | Required with                   |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------|
| Assigned                  | The work order has been assigned to an AppFolio Property Manager user | `AssignedUsers` or `VendorId` |
| Canceled                  | The work order has been canceled                            | `CanceledOn`                    |
| Completed                 | The maintenance request was closed out                      | `CompletedOn`                   |
| Completed No Need To Bill | The work order was completed and does not need to be billed | `CompletedOn`                   |
| New                       | A new maintenance request                                   | —                               |
| Ready to Bill             | The work order is ready to be billed                        | —                               |
| Scheduled                 | Work is scheduled                                           | `ScheduledStart`, `ScheduledEnd`|
| Waiting                   | The work order is pending                                   | —                               |
| Work Done                 | The work has been completed                                 | `WorkCompletedOn`               |

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the work order to update

AssignedUsers.description:
Array of `AssignedUsers` IDs to be updated. Please pass in all the assigned users you want to keep.
  When this is empty, it will drop all assigned users.
  When this is `null` or not passed in, it will not change the assigned users.

Description.description: The top-level description for a grouping of work orders in AppFolio

InventoryDetails.description:
Array of `InventoryDetails` objects to be updated. Please pass in all the inventory details you want to keep.
  When this is empty, it will drop all inventory details.
  When this is `null` or not passed in, it will not change the inventory details.

InventoryId.description: Required. Unique identifier of the inventory item

GlAccountId.description: Unique identifier of the GL account associated with the inventory detail

Quantity.description: The quantity of the inventory item used

Rate.description: The rate (cost) of the inventory item

JobDescription.description: A brief description of the work order to be performed

ManagementCompanyAsVendor.description: Indicates whether or not the management company is the vendor for the work order. If false, the assigned vendor company will be dropped.

PermissionToEnter.description: Occupancy has given permission to enter unit

Array of purchase order IDs to be linked to the work order. Please pass in all the purchase orders you want to keep.
  When this is empty, it will unlink all purchase orders.
  When this is `null` or not passed in, it will not change the linked purchase orders.
  Each ID must reference an existing purchase order that is visible to the caller and must not be duplicated within the array.

ScheduledEnd.description: When the work order is scheduled to be completed. If `ScheduledEnd` is null, it will be considered scheduled for 'all day'. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` and the default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

ScheduledStart.description: When the work order is scheduled to start. Set this value together with `ScheduledEnd`. The time difference between `ScheduledStart` and `ScheduledEnd` should not exceed 12 hours unless it is an scheduled for 'all day'. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` and the default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

VendorId.description: Unique identifier of the vendor associated with the work order. When the value of this attribute is null, it will drop the assigned vendor. When present, `ManagementCompanyAsVendor` cannot be true.

CustomFieldId.description:
The value of the `CustomField` to update. Ensure the value set for `CustomFieldId` matches the type that was set for the `CustomField` at creation.
For example, if `boolean` is the type set for the `CustomField` associated with this `CustomFieldId`, the value set here must be either `true` or `false`. *Note*: To clear the value of a `CustomField`, set `CustomFieldId` to `null` in the PATCH request. For array-type custom fields (select_multiple), use an empty array `[]` or empty string `""` instead of `null`, as `null` will be ignored.

WorkOrder.Estimates.Update.title: Estimates
WorkOrder.Estimates.Update.description:
Use estimates to track anticipated costs for Work Orders. Estimates created via API are not automatically sent to Vendors or Owners, but are visible to assigned Vendors in the Vendor Portal.
**DO NOT INCLUDE Estimates unless one or more estimates have changed**.
Passing any number of estimates will replace all existing estimates for the work order. Passing an empty array `[]` will remove all existing estimates for the work order.

VendorId.description: The unique identifier of the vendor who submitted this estimate. If provided, `ManagementCompanyAsVendor` must be `false` or omitted.

ManagementCompanyAsVendor.description: Indicates whether or not the management company is acting as the vendor for the estimate. If `true`, `VendorId` must be `null` or omitted.

Amount.description: The total estimated cost in dollars for completing the work order as quoted by the vendor.

InternalNotes.description: Internal notes or comments attached to the estimate. These notes are for internal use only and not visible to vendors or owners.

EstimateRequestedDate.description: The date the estimate was requested from the Vendor.

EstimateReceivedDate.description: The date the estimate was received from the Vendor. If `Amount` is provided but `EstimateReceivedDate` is not specified, it will automatically default to today's date. This ensures that all estimates with amounts have a received date for tracking purposes.

WorkOrder.StatusForWriter.title: Status
WorkOrder.StatusForWriter.description:
**Deprecated — use `WorkOrderStatus` instead.** `Status` accepts a collapsed subset of AppFolio Property Manager statuses; `WorkOrderStatus` accepts the full, unflattened writable set (for example, "Completed No Need To Bill", "Work Done", and "Ready to Bill"). This attribute is mutually exclusive with `WorkOrderStatus`; a request cannot set both.

The status of the work order. The `Status` is automatically updated to `Estimate Requested` or `Estimated` based on the `Estimates` associated with it.
When one or more estimates exist on a work order, the work order status becomes `Estimate Requested`.
Once any estimate has an `Amount` provided, the work order status transitions to `Estimated`.
#### Status Options
| Options            | Description                      |
|--------------------|----------------------------------|
| Assigned           | The work order has been assigned to an AppFolio Property Manager user |
| Canceled           | The work order has been canceled                |
| Completed          | The maintenance request was closed out   |
| New                | A new maintenance request          |
| Scheduled          | The work order to be performed is scheduled                |
| Waiting            | The work order is pending                         |
| Work Completed     | The work order is completed                   |

WorkOrder.WorkOrderStatusForWriter.title: WorkOrderStatus
WorkOrder.WorkOrderStatusForWriter.description:
The status of the work order, matching the statuses available in AppFolio Property Manager. This attribute is mutually exclusive with the deprecated `Status` attribute; a request cannot set both. The read-only statuses `Estimate Requested` and `Estimated` (managed through the estimate flow) and `New by AppFolio` and `Assigned by AppFolio` (set by AppFolio Smart Maintenance agents or the system) cannot be set through the API. Some statuses require a companion attribute in the same request, shown in the "Required with" column below; omitting it returns a 422.
#### Status Options
| Options                   | Description                                                 | Required with                   |
|---------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------|
| Assigned                  | The work order has been assigned to an AppFolio Property Manager user | `AssignedUsers` or `VendorId` |
| Canceled                  | The work order has been canceled                            | `CanceledOn`                    |
| Completed                 | The maintenance request was closed out                      | `CompletedOn`                   |
| Completed No Need To Bill | The work order was completed and does not need to be billed | `CompletedOn`                   |
| New                       | A new maintenance request                                   | —                               |
| Ready to Bill             | The work order is ready to be billed                        | —                               |
| Scheduled                 | Work is scheduled                                           | `ScheduledStart`, `ScheduledEnd`|
| Waiting                   | The work order is pending                                   | —                               |
| Work Done                 | The work has been completed                                 | `WorkCompletedOn`               |

operations.name: getWorkOrdersNotes
operations.description:
List All Work Order Notes
Returns work order notes. Filter by `WorkOrderId` to return the notes for a single work order, or by `LastUpdatedAtFrom` to return notes across all work orders.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional pagination parameters. The default parameters are recommended but can be modified if a different sized response is desired.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filters for work order notes. All GET requests must include a filter for `[WorkOrderId]` or `[LastUpdatedAtFrom]`.

WorkOrderId.description:
Example: `filters[WorkOrderId]=1abcde23-c543-456e-abc9-123456789cba`
Unique identifier of the work order. Filter the results based on a single value.

LastUpdatedAtFrom.description:
Example: `filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]=2021-12-15T16:30:46Z`
Returns work order note records that have been updated since the date provided. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`, and the default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).
